defaultPackage: src, dist and tests unchanged; SHA-256 fingerprints verified

benchmarks.zip: Bit-identical encoded SHA-256 per fixture; independently verified decoded SHA-256, bytes and CRC-32.

diagnostics: 15 separate untimed exports; exact ZIP input bytes and encoded digest verified; one data statement/execution each
memory: Whole-process maximum RSS including startup, verification, warmup and three timed exports; across-suite maximum is observed, not a hard bound. Natural GC; no explicit collection.
timing: Timing medians of five fresh-worker medians, three timed exports per worker. Rotating method order; all observations retained. Small timing differences on varied fixtures overlap run-to-run variation.
adaptive: Historical p95 of last 64 total batch byte sizes, target 256 KiB, 10% headroom, initial 64 rows, growth <=2x and 1–65536 rows. Controller ported to optimized SQL; callback state scoped to iterator so cancellation/completion clears it. Prepare-only adapters keep the fixed 256 fallback; no public option or declarations changed.
